story.titleZh: 阿尔派车队实时战报：第20圈场上位置胶着
story.summaryZh: 阿尔派车队在X平台发布比赛实时更新：第20圈（共51圈）皮埃尔前后车手位置出现变化，诺里斯以2.9秒领跑在他前方，弗朗哥则落后安特3.4秒。
story.originalTitle: LAP 20/51: No change in positions, but there is to the cars around us. NOR is now the car ahead of Pierre, +2.9s up the road. Franco has ANT +3.4s beh...
story.summaryEn:
LAP 20/51:
No change in positions, but there is to the cars around us. 
NOR is now the car ahead of Pierre, +2.9s up the road. Franco has ANT +3.4s behind.
detailZh: 第20圈（共51圈）：我们的位置没有变化，但周围的车辆发生了变化。诺里斯（NOR）现在是皮埃尔（Pierre）前方的车辆，领先2.9秒。弗朗哥（Franco）落后安特（ANT）3.4秒。
detailEn:
LAP 20/51:
No change in positions, but there is to the cars around us. 
NOR is now the car ahead of Pierre, +2.9s up the road. Franco has ANT +3.4s behind.
keyPointsZh: 比赛共51圈，目前进行到第20圈
keyPointsEn: The race is 51 laps long, currently on lap 20.
Norris is 2.9 seconds ahead of Pierre.
